fr.descriptionLogement:

Il se compose d’une galerie d’entrée, d'un salon et d'une salle à manger ainsi que d'une cuisine séparée. L'appartement est doté d'une trés belle hauteur sous plafond (3.5m) et de vues dégagées sur des jardins de part et d'autre.

en.titreDuLogement: Paris 16 - La Muette / Beauséjour - 4-bed apartment + 1 office
en.descriptionLogement:

It also comprises 4 bedrooms, 1 study, 3 bathrooms with WCs, a shower room with WC, a large walk-in wardrobe, a guest WC and a linen room/laundry room.

fr.titreDuLogement: Paris 8 - Place Beauvau - Appartement d'exception - 2 suites -  Volumes exceptionnels
fr.descriptionLogement:
Paris 8 - Place Beauvau - Appartement d'exception - 2 suites - Volumes exceptionnels.
Au cœur du 8ème arrondissement, rue des Saussaies, à deux pas du Palais de l'Élysée et de la place Beauvau, cet appartement de 216 m² (209,66 m2 Carrez) allie le patrimoine du Second Empire à un raffinement contemporain. Moulures dorées, cheminées en marbre et parquet Versailles composent un écrin d'une rare élégance.
L'appartement est entièrement climatisé.
Le double salon se pare de lustres en cristal et de boiseries d'époque restaurées. La suite parentale dispose d'un dressing et d'une salle de bains avec baignoire et douche séparées. Une seconde suite, pensée pour les invités, offre son propre dressing, une salle de bains en marbre veiné et un bureau attenant baigné de lumière.
L'adresse conjugue prestige institutionnel et art de vivre parisien. La rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré et ses maisons de luxe se trouvent à quelques pas. Les jardins des Champs-Élysées, le Grand Palais et le Petit Palais se rejoignent en quelques minutes à pied, tout comme la place de la Concorde, la Madeleine et l'avenue Montaigne. Galeries d'art, palaces et tables gastronomiques animent ce quartier parmi les plus recherchés de Paris.
Nombreuses options de transport à proximité.

en.titreDuLogement: Paris 8th Arrondissement - Elysée Beauvau - Exceptional Apartment - 2 Suites - Spacious Rooms
en.descriptionLogement:
Paris 8th Arrondissement - Place Beauvau - Exceptional Apartment - 2 Suites - Spacious Rooms
In the heart of the 8th arrondissement, on Rue des Saussaies, a stone's throw from the Élysée Palace and Place Beauvau, this 209 sq m (2,260 sq ft) apartment blends Second Empire heritage with contemporary refinement. Gilded moldings, marble fireplaces, and Versailles parquet flooring create an atmosphere of rare elegance.
The apartment is fully air-conditioned.
The double living room features crystal chandeliers and restored period woodwork. The master suite includes a dressing room and a bathroom with a separate bathtub and shower. A second suite, designed for guests, offers its own dressing room, a bathroom with veined marble, and an adjoining, light-filled office.
The address combines institutional prestige with the Parisian art of living. The Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré and its luxury boutiques are just steps away. The Champs-Élysées gardens, the Grand Palais, and the Petit Palais are all within a few minutes' walk, as are the Place de la Concorde, the Madeleine Church, and Avenue Montaigne. Art galleries, luxury hotels, and gourmet restaurants enliven this area, one of the most sought-after in Paris.
Numerous transportation options provide easy access to the area.

fr.titreDuLogement: Paris 7 - Champ de Mars - Appartement - Etage élevé - 200m²  - Vues - 4/5 chambres
fr.descriptionLogement:
Au 5ème étage d'un bel immeuble 1910, avec gardien à demeure, appartement de standing de 200m².
L'appartement dispose d'une vaste double-réception donnant sur balcon, d'un bureau pouvant être aménagé en chambre ouvert sur un second balcon avec vue Tour Eiffel, d'une cuisine dînatoire, d'une chambre sur cour, d'une salle de douche avec toilettes.
La partie nuit comprend une suite parentale avec dressing, salle de douche et toilettes, trois autres chambres, une salle de bains, deux toilettes séparées ainsi qu'un espace buanderie.
Une cave.
Situé à une adresse prestigieuse, ce bien réunit les qualités prisées d'une résidence familiale comme celles d'un élégant pied-à-terre : étage élevé, vue dégagée sur le Champ de Mars, belle hauteur sous plafond (2.95m).
Bien soumis au régime de la copropriété.
Une adresse résidentielle prestigieuse et verdoyante, nichée dans un secteur calme et très sécurisé du 7e arrondissement. Bordé d'allées arborées à deux pas du Champ-de-Mars, le quartier offre une qualité de vie remarquable, idéale pour les familles. L'adresse bénéficie de l'accès immédiat à des établissements d'excellence et de la proximité de la très prisée école bilingue Jeannine-Manuel.

en.titreDuLogement: Paris 7th – Champ de Mars – Apartment – High Floor – 200 sq m – Views
en.descriptionLogement:
On the fifth floor of a fine 1910 building with a live‑in caretaker, a prestigious 200 sq m (approx. 2,153 sq ft) apartment.
The apartment offers a vast double reception room (two interconnecting reception rooms) opening onto a balcony, a study that could be converted into a bedroom and opens onto a second balcony with views of the Eiffel Tower, an eat‑in kitchen, and a shower room with a separate WC.
The sleeping quarters comprise a principal suite with a dressing room, shower room and WC, three further bedrooms, a bathroom, two separate WCs, and a utility room.
A cellar.
Set on a prestigious address, this property combines the qualities sought after in a family residence with those of an elegant pied‑à‑terre: a high floor, unobstructed views over the Champ de Mars, generous ceiling height (2.95 m).
The property is subject to co‑ownership regulations.
A prestigious and verdant residential address, nestled in a quiet and highly secure pocket of the 7th arrondissement. Framed by tree-lined streets just steps from the Champ-de-Mars, the neighborhood offers a remarkable quality of life, perfect for families. The location benefits from direct access to top-tier educational institutions, including the highly sought-after Collège Jules Romains school zoning. Transport connectivity is excellent, with the RER C (Champ de Mars - Tour Eiffel station) and Line 6 (Bir-Hakeim station) only a few minutes' walk away.

fr.titreDuLogement: Paris 7 - Champ-de-Mars - Appartement familial et de réception - Charme et volumes - 4 chambres
fr.descriptionLogement:
Au sein d'une copropriété des années trente de grand standing avec gardien, à proximité immédiate du Champ-de-Mars et de l'Ecole Militaire, appartement de 254,82 m² loi Carrez situé au premier étage avec ascenseur.
Traversant, ensoleillé et offrant de très beaux volumes, cet appartement à rénover comprend une galerie d'entrée, une double réception, une salle à manger, une cuisine dinatoire, un bureau (quatrième chambre possible), une salle de douche, trois suites (deux avec salle de douche et une avec salle de bains et toilettes), des toilettes invités.
Nombreux rangements dans l'appartement.
La luminosité, l'élégance et le calme sont quelques uns des atouts de ce bien.
En annexe, une chambre de service au 7ème étage ainsi qu'une grande cave saine.
Possibilité d'acquérir en option deux autres chambres de service. L'une de 10,89 m² loi carrez en très bon état au rez-de-chaussée avec cuisine, douche et WC. La seconde au 7ème étage.
Bien soumis au régime de la copropriété.
Une adresse résidentielle prestigieuse et verdoyante dans le 7e arrondissement.
Ce secteur familial et très sécurisé offre un cadre de vie exceptionnel, à quelques pas de l’avenue de Saxe et de son marché réputé. Le quotidien y est privilégié grâce aux commerces de bouche de la rue de Cler et à la sectorisation d'écoles de renom.
Face au Champ-de-Mars, les résidents profitent d'un environnement aéré et calme. Rues arborées et proximité de la Seine complètent ce bien d’exception.

en.titreDuLogement: Paris 7 - Champ-de-Mars - Family apartment with reception rooms - Charm and volume - 4 bedrooms
en.descriptionLogement:
This 254.82m² or 2,743 sq ft (Carrez Law) apartment is situated on the first floor of a high-end 1930s shared ownership building with concierge and lift, close to the Champ-de-Mars and the École Militaire.
This dual-aspect, sunny apartment to renovate offers great volume and comprises an entrance hall, a double-sized reception room, a dining room, an eat-in kitchen, an office (fourth bedroom possible), a shower room, three suites (two of which have a shower room and one of which has a bathroom and toilet), and a guest toilet.
Plenty of storage space.
Natural light, elegance and peace and quiet are just some of this property’s key features.
In addition, there is a maid’s room on the 7th floor and a large, damp-free cellar.
Option to purchase two additional maid’s rooms. One measuring 10.89m² or 117 sq ft (Carrez Law), in immaculate condition, situated on the ground floor, with a kitchen, shower and toilet. The second is on the 7th floor.
Property subject to shared ownership status. Fees payable by the seller - Number of lots in the building: 28 - Average amount of the share of charges €17,431/year - Estimated amount of annual energy costs for standard use: €5,700 ~ €7,860
A prestigious and verdant residential address in the 7th arrondissement.
This highly secure, family-friendly area offers an exceptional living environment, just steps away from Avenue de Saxe and its renowned open-air market. Daily life is seamless here, thanks to the premium food shops on Rue de Cler and excellent local school zoning.
Facing the Champ-de-Mars, residents enjoy airy, quiet surroundings. Tree-lined streets and close proximity to the Seine complete this ultra-premium location.

fr.titreDuLogement: Paris 8 - Triangle d´Or / Marbeuf - Appartement d´angle - 3 chambres - Balcon filant - Etage élevé
fr.descriptionLogement:
Paris 8 - Triangle d´Or / Marbeuf - Appartement d´angle - 3 chambres - Balcon filant - Etage élevé
Au 5ème étage d´un immeuble haussmannien construit en 1885, un appartement d´angle de 164 m2 environ (169,9 m2 Carrez) avec deux balcons (totalisant 22,5 m2) comprenant une entrée, un grand séjour, une salle à manger, une cuisine dinatoire, une chambre parentale avec son dressing, sa salle de bains et toilette, deux autres chambres, une salle de bains et toilette, un dressing et un toilette invités.

en.titreDuLogement: Paris 8th – Triangle d'Or / Marbeuf – Corner apartment – 3 bedrooms – Wrap-around balcony – High floor
en.descriptionLogement:
Paris 8th – Triangle d'Or / Marbeuf – Corner apartment – 3 bedrooms – Wrap-around balcony – High floor

The property boasts high ceilings, abundant natural light, and air conditioning.
Two cellar storage units and a maid's room on the 6th floor complete the property.

fr.titreDuLogement: Nouveauté Paris 5 Val de Grâce : exceptionnel appartement, triple réception, 4-5 chambres, vues rares
fr.descriptionLogement:
BARNES Panthéon présente en exclusivité un appartement d'exception de 188,37 m² loi Carrez (208.3 m² de surface totale), au cinquième étage avec ascenseur d'un bel immeuble 1900. Ce bien rare, juste en face du majestueux dôme du Val-de-Grâce, offre de superbes vues dégagées sur le ciel et sur la coupole de l'un des plus beaux monuments historiques de Paris.
Dès l'entrée, la hauteur sous plafond de 3 mètres et des corniches et moulures d'une grande richesse donnent le ton. Une triple réception totalisant 75 m² ouvre sur plusieurs balcons filants (plus de 18m² d'extérieur) et cette vue rare. L'une des pièces de réception peut facilement devenir une grande chambre supplémentaire. La cuisine séparée, équipée et remise au goût du jour, est complétée par un débarras et par un accès privatif à une passerelle sur le palier menant à l'escalier de service.
Côté nuit, l'appartement compte quatre chambres confortables au calme, dont une pouvant accueillir une chambre d'enfant ou un bureau. Il dispose aussi de deux salles de bains, d'un dressing séparé et de toilettes séparées. De nombreux rangements complètent l'ensemble.
Ce volume d'époque préservé laisse à ses futurs acquéreurs le soin d'imaginer un intérieur sur mesure dans la parfaite tradition des immeubles anciens (parquet, moulures, cheminées, balcons, hauteur sous plafond). L'immeuble dispose d'un gardien et est raccordé au chauffage urbain (DPE D). Quadruple exposition : est (côté Val-de-Grâce), nord, ouest et sud.
Cet appartement est présenté en exclusivité par Nicolas Watrin, tél. .
À deux pas du jardin du Luxembourg, le quartier du Val-de-Grâce est l'un des plus prisés de la Rive Gauche. Il est dominé par l'église Notre-Dame du Val-de-Grâce, fondée par Anne d'Autriche après la naissance de Louis XIV. Sa coupole abrite la fresque de Pierre Mignard, célébrée par Molière, et l'église conserve quatre tableaux de Philippe de Champaigne. Les commerces de la rue Saint-Jacques et les grands lycées de la Montagne Sainte-Geneviève sont à quelques pas.
Transports : RER B (Port-Royal) et nombreux bus à proximité.
Sectorisation collège : Lavoisier.
Biens soumis au statut de la copropriété.
Les informations sur les risques auxquels ce bien est exposé sont disponibles sur le site Géorisques: www.georisques.gouv.fr

en.titreDuLogement: Paris 5 Val de Grâce: exceptional apartment, triple reception room, 4-5 bedrooms, rare views
en.descriptionLogement:
BARNES Panthéon exclusively presents an exceptional apartment of 188.37 sq m (Carrez law) / 208.3 sq m total, on the fifth floor with elevator of a beautiful 1900 building. This rare property, directly opposite the majestic dome of the Val-de-Grâce, offers breathtaking unobstructed views of the sky, the dome of one of Paris's most beautiful historical monuments, and the former abbey.
From the moment you enter, the 3-meter high ceilings and exceptional cornices and moldings set the tone. A triple reception room totaling 75 sq m opens onto continuous balconies and this rare view. One of the reception rooms could easily be converted into a large additional bedroom. The separate, fully equipped, and updated kitchen is complemented by a storage room and private access to a walkway on the landing leading to the service staircase.
On the bedroom side, the apartment features four comfortable and quiet bedrooms, one of which could be used as a child's room or an office. It also includes two bathrooms, a separate dressing room, and a guest toilet. Ample storage space completes the layout.
Habitable as is, this well-preserved period property also allows its future owners the opportunity to design a bespoke interior. The building has a concierge and is connected to the district heating system. The apartment faces east (overlooking Val-de-Grâce), north, west, and south.
This apartment is presented exclusively by Nicolas Watrin, tel. .
Just steps from the Luxembourg Gardens, the Val-de-Grâce district is one of the most sought-after on the Left Bank. It is dominated by the Notre-Dame du Val-de-Grâce church, founded by Anne of Austria after the birth of Louis XIV. Its dome houses a fresco by Pierre Mignard, celebrated by Molière. The shops on Rue Saint-Jacques and the prestigious high schools on Montagne Sainte-Geneviève are within easy walking distance.
School catchment area: Lavoisier.
Property subject to co-ownership regulations.
Information on the risks to which this property is exposed is available on the Géorisques website: www.georisques.gouv.fr

fr.titreDuLogement: Paris V - Boulevard Saint-Germain - Appartement d'exception - Sublime rénovation
fr.descriptionLogement:
Paris V - Situé à une adresse parisienne recherchée, à quelques pas seulement de Notre Dame, des quais de Seine et du marché Maubert, BARNES Panthéon vous présente ce luxueux appartement de 125m² magnifiquement rénové, situé au 2ème étage par ascenseur d'une copropriété de qualité, et prolongé d'un balcon filant de 10m² exposé Sud.
Ce bien unique décoré par une architecte renommée, offre une vaste entrée, un séjour de plus de 40m², une cuisine faisant office de salle à manger, une suite parentale avec double dressing, salle de bains/douche et toilettes privatifs, une suite d'invité (avec salle de douche et toilettes privatifs), une buanderie et des toilettes invités.
Prestations haut de gamme, noblesse des matériaux, aménagements entièrement sur mesure pour ce bien exceptionnel présentant un plan parfait, et situé dans le centre historique de Paris. L'appartement est entièrement climatisé et proposé à la vente entièrement meublé.

en.titreDuLogement: Paris 5 – Boulevard Saint-Germain – Exceptional apartment – Stunning renovation
en.descriptionLogement:
Paris 5 – BARNES Panthéon is listing this luxurious 125m² (1,345 sq ft) apartment, beautifully renovated, with a 10m² (108 sq ft) south-facing continuous balcony. This unique property, decorated by a renowned architect, features a large entrance hall, a 40m² (431 sq ft) living room, a kitchen doubling as a dining room, a master suite with a double wardrobe, en-suite bath/shower room and toilet, a guest suite (with shower room and toilet), a laundry room and a guest toilet.
High-end amenities, refined materials and entirely custom-built fittings characterise this exceptional property, which boasts a perfect floor plan, in the historic centre of Paris. The apartment is fully air conditioned and is sold fully furnished.
An 18m² (194 sq ft) cellar rounds off the property.

fr.titreDuLogement: Paris 17 - Malesherbes / Carnot - Duplex aux derniers étages - 8 chambres – Volumes exceptionnels
fr.descriptionLogement:
Paris 17 - Malesherbes / Carnot - Duplex aux derniers étages - 8 chambres – Volumes exceptionnels
Plaine Monceau, proche du lycée Carnot, au sein d’une copropriété édifiée en 1898, cet ancien atelier transformé en habitation en 1920 développe une surface de 318 m² sur deux niveaux.
Situé au calme sur cour, l’appartement se distingue par ses volumes atypiques.
Au troisième étage, l’entrée dessert un dressing invités, un salon bénéficiant d’une hauteur sous plafond de près de 6 mètres, ainsi qu’une chambre accessible par un escalier. Sous celle-ci se trouvent une salle de bains, une seconde chambre et l’accès à un ascenseur privatif. Une salle à manger, deux autres chambres, une cuisine et des toilettes indépendantes complètent ce niveau.
Au quatrième étage se trouvent un bureau, trois chambres, une salle de bains, des toilettes indépendantes, une buanderie et plusieurs espaces de rangement, dont un donnant accès au grenier.
Un appartement unique aux volumes généreux, offrant de nombreuses possibilités d’aménagement.
Un grand box dans la cour et une cave viennent compléter ce bien.

en.titreDuLogement: Paris 17th – Malesherbes / Carnot – Exceptional 7 bedrooms Duplex Apartment on the top floors
en.descriptionLogement:
Paris 17th – Malesherbes / Carnot – Exceptional Duplex Apartment on the top foors.
Located in the prime Plaine Monceau neighborhood, close to Lycée Carnot, this former plumbing workshop was converted into a residence in 1920. Housed in a handsome 1898 building, this unique property offers 318 sq.m (3,423 sq.ft) of living space across two levels.
Quietly set off the courtyard, the apartment features striking architectural volumes.
On the third floor, the entrance leads to a guest walk-in closet, an expansive living room featuring nearly 6-meter (20-foot) high ceilings, and a bedroom accessed by its own dedicated staircase. Positioned beneath it are a bathroom, a second bedroom, and access to a private elevator. A dining room, two additional bedrooms, a separate kitchen, and an independent restroom complete this level.
The fourth floor comprises a home office, three bedrooms, a bathroom, an independent restroom, a laundry room, and extensive storage spaces, including one providing access to the attic.
A truly one-of-a-kind property offering extraordinary proportions and vast potential for reconfiguration.

fr.titreDuLogement: Paris 17 Courcelles / Parc Monceau - Appartement 4 chambres - 5ème étage - balcon filant
fr.descriptionLogement:
Paris 17 Courcelles/ Parc Monceau - Appartement 4 chambres - étage élevé - balcon filant

en.titreDuLogement: Paris 17th — Courcelles / Parc Monceau — 4-bedroom apartment with running balcony
en.descriptionLogement:
Paris 17th — Courcelles / Parc Monceau — 4-bedroom apartment with running balcony
Located on the 5th floor (with elevator) of a high-end Haussmannian building, this 258 sq. m (2,777 sq. ft) apartment includes an entrance hall, a double reception room opening onto a running balcony, a formal dining room, an independent kitchen, a bedroom with ensuite shower room and walk-in closet, two additional bedrooms, a separate shower room, a laundry room, and a guest rest room.

Includes a private cellar.
Zoned for top-ranking Carnot public school, and steps away from the École Internationale Bilingue (EIB).

fr.titreDuLogement: Exclusivité - Paris 16ème - Dernier étage - Vue panoramique
fr.descriptionLogement:
Bel appartement traversant d'environ 150 m² situé au 10ème étage d'un immeuble fraichement ravalé datant de 1954 bordé de plusieurs balcons /terrasses d'une surface totale d'environ 60 m² offrant une vue extraordinaire sur le Bois de Boulogne, le Mont Valérien, Paris et ses plus beaux monuments.

Bien soumis au régime de la copropriété

en.titreDuLogement: Exclusive listing - Paris 16 - Top floor - Panoramic view
en.descriptionLogement:
Stunning 150m² (1,615 sq ft) dual-aspect apartment on the 10th floor of a newly re-rendered building dating from 1954, with several balconies/terraces totalling 60m² (646 sq ft) affording fabulous views over the Bois de Boulogne, Mont Valérien, Paris and its iconic monuments.
A vestibule accessed directly from the lift opens onto an entrance leading to a spacious dual-aspect reception room and a furnished and equipped open kitchen boasting wide balconies/terraces and a captivating view of the Paris skyline.
The sleeping area comprises a master suite with shower room and a good-sized walk-in wardrobe, two children’s bedrooms (one with a pleasant desk area), a shower room and a laundry room.

fr.titreDuLogement: Paris 6ème, Appartement 3 Chambres - 188 m² en location
fr.descriptionLogement:
Dans un élégant immeuble en pierre de taille édifié au XIXe siècle, sécurisé avec gardien, appartement d'exception situé aux derniers étages avec ascenseur, développant une superficie de 188,29 m² habitables (230,67 m² au sol).
Dès l'entrée, l'espace s'impose par une double réception traversante sur rue et cour.
Servi par une exposition est et ouest, la lumière naturelle y est remarquable tout au long de la journée, sublimée par des vues sur monuments historiques.

en.titreDuLogement: Landmarked Federal Townhouse with Private Garden – Tribeca

Positioned on the coveted southwest corner of Harrison and Greenwich Streets, this historic TriBeCa home is one of just nine landmarked Federal houses with private gardens, making it an especially distinctive offering in downtown Manhattan. A welcoming entry foyer opens through a fluted-glass door to the gracious parlor-floor living room, where a fireplace, oversized historically correct windows, and direct access to the private garden create an elegant setting for everyday living and entertaining. Up a gentle staircase, the second floor is devoted primarily to the luxurious primary bedroom suite. The en-suite primary bathroom is clad in warm golden Travertine marble and includes a luxurious walk-in shower, custom-designed sink, and bespoke cabinetry. Also on this level is a second windowed bedroom or study with a third fireplace. Large south-facing windows overlook the home's private trees and gardens, offering a serene outlook that changes beautifully with the seasons—from snow-covered branches in winter to abundant blooms in spring and summer. The third floor features two additional large bedrooms, each with generous closet space and oversized windows that fill the rooms with sunlight. The bedrooms share a full modern bathroom and offer flexibility for family, guests, a home office, or additional living needs. The lower level provides an inviting family room and media/entertainment space, complete with wall-to-wall cabinetry, a high window, and ample room for a full media installation. A generous custom workspace includes a built-in desk, cabinetry, and shelving. This level also features a full pantry, cedar closet, full modern bathroom, vented laundry room, additional storage, and building systems. Modern infrastructure complements the historic character of this TriBeCa townhouse. The home is equipped with two-zone heating and three-zone air conditioning, providing year-round comfort. For nearly 35 years, 25 Harrison has been the cherished home of one family. Lovingly renovated, thoughtfully maintained, and exceptionally well positioned, this historic TriBeCa townhouse with a private garden offers a rare opportunity to own a truly special piece of downtown Manhattan. en.titreDuLogement: Romanesque Revival Four-Family Townhouse – Hamilton Heights
en.descriptionLogement:
A House Beneath The Trees ...

Certain streets encourage you to take your time. West 149th Street has long been one of those blocks. Whether heading east or west, it has always been worth the walk.

Standing as naturally today as it has for generations, 531 West 149th Street is a beautiful example of Romanesque Revival design. Its rounded bay, carved brownstone detailing, elegant stoop, and wrought-iron gate offer only the first indication of the warmth and individuality waiting within.

Long before arriving at the first residence, the house begins telling its story. Mosaic tile floors, rich wood paneling, wainscoting, transoms, and millwork introduce an earlier era, when craftsmanship found its place in everyday spaces. Above, the galvanized steel skylight fills the central stair hall with an ever-changing, sculptural interplay of light and shadow.

Each residence is individual in its own way, yet unmistakably part of a greater whole. Throughout the house, fireplace ensembles remain among its finest details. Carved wood mantels with overmantel mirrors, richly patterned ceramic tile surrounds and hearths, and sculptural cast-iron fireboxes define the principal rooms. Elevated ceilings, moldings, trim, tall windows framed by their time-honored interior shutters, and north and south exposures further distinguish each floor.

Kitchens have been thoughtfully refreshed through the years, their updates sitting comfortably alongside the house's original character. Each full-floor residence retains both front and rear entrances, a feature offering flexibility while recalling an earlier way of living.

The south-facing rooms enjoy a wonderful relationship with the surrounding canopy. Depending upon the season, they seem to rest beneath the leaves, among them, or just above them, gently reminding you that nature still has a place in Manhattan. The third-floor rounded bay becomes one of the house's favorite places, its built-in window seat asking nothing of you except to stay a little longer. Above, the fourth-floor bath offers its own retreat beneath a skylight, a place to disappear for a while.

And then there's the house itself. For more than a century, it has welcomed one chapter after another, gracefully and irresistibly, never needing to be anything other than itself.

Its doors have opened to generations of residents. Now, a new kind of welcome awaits.

There is still room for imagination here.

Currently arranged as four free-market, full-floor residences, the house offers more than one way forward. It can continue much as it is, with four independent homes and the income they provide. Or perhaps the more interesting possibility lies somewhere in between.

For an owner who wants more of the house for themselves, the existing floor-through arrangement lends itself naturally to combination. The Garden and Parlor floors could come together as an owner's duplex with the private garden, while the Third and Fourth floors remain independent residences above. At projected rents of approximately $3,300-$3,500 per month each, those homes could continue providing meaningful income.

Another possibility is to divide the house into two substantial duplex residences-Garden and Parlor below, Third and Fourth above.

Or take more of the house: Garden, Parlor and Third could become a three-level owner's residence, with the Fourth Floor remaining an independent full-floor home.

For someone drawn to house living but not necessarily to giving over the entire building to a single residence, these possibilities offer an intriguing middle ground: more house for yourself, with income still working elsewhere. A legal reduction to three residences or fewer may also result in a different NYC property-tax classification and potentially meaningful tax savings. Any future tax treatment is property-specific and should be independently verified.

Others may ultimately see the entire house as one home. The existing layout does not insist upon a single answer. It simply leaves the possibilities open.

Carefully maintained, the property has benefited from ongoing improvements, including a recent roof replacement, reflecting the same thoughtful care found throughout.

With approximately 3,500 square feet above grade, a 788-square-foot cellar, and 928 square feet of outdoor space, there is still more to consider. More than 1,600 square feet of additional FAR is believed to remain, offering further flexibility for those who may wish to thoughtfully expand in the future, subject to applicable zoning and approvals.

Get to know the allure of Hamilton Heights. A century ago, and every bit as much today, there is something undeniably captivating about this part of Manhattan. Here in historic Sugar Hill, architecture, history, and a certain unmistakable magic have long made this corner of Manhattan a favorite.

Riverside Park, Riverbank State Park, Columbia University, City College, restaurants, everyday essentials, and easy transportation are all close at hand, with convenient bridge, tunnel, train, bus, and highway access in and out of Manhattan. Whether the occasion calls for dressing up or not, the neighborhood offers plenty of reasons to stay close to home.

Some houses impress the moment you arrive. Others reveal themselves a little at a time. 531 West 149th Street does both, leaving a lasting impression not because it asks for attention, but because it never tried to.

The Hudson lies beyond the treetops of Riverbank State Park, while Manhattan gathers itself into rooftops, water towers, bridges, and skyline. Often, river and city share the same window. One is quiet and bright, set at the corner where picture-postcard windows meet above the Hudson and treetops, and accessed through a wonderfully unexpected rock-climbing entrance. The other is warmer and more intimate, with the water, sky, and cityscape continuing beyond its windows.

There is a playful spirit woven into the walls as well, with two projectors set up to turn the rooms into private cinemas after dark.

Designed by Meltzer/Mandl Architects, River Bridge Court connects its six- and eleven-story buildings with a landscaped open-air bridge. There is a 24-hour attended lobby, a proper gym, bicycle storage, and a rooftop terrace that understands exactly where it is.

Up there, the Hudson takes over.

The panorama carries the eye across the water, past the bridges and Manhattan skyline, and toward the far shore. Stay until sunset and the whole scene changes again.

River Bridge Court sits at the western edge of historic Hamilton Heights, where the neighborhood meets the waterfront. Riverbank State Park is practically outside your door, Saint Nicholas Park lies in the other direction, and Broadway's restaurants, cafés, shops, and public transportation are all nearby. Major routes make reaching the city's bridges, tunnels, highways, and drives, and getting in, out of, and around Manhattan particularly easy.

The neighborhood is outside your door. The Hudson is outside your window.

Down below, the city carries on.

In 11C, there is room to breathe.
